name: spec2plan
description: Transform feature specifications into context-rich implementation plans and executable task registries. Outputs implementation-plan.md (approach, decisions, risks, traceability) and tasks.md (self-sufficient tasks with pattern references, imports, gotchas and runnable validation commands). Story-first phasing with shippable checkpoints and explicit parallel-safety. Includes spec2plan orchestrator and spec2plan_sub domain expert agents.
